page_title: SEV 1-0 RAY | Sevilla v Rayo Vallecano 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+4' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
90+2' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to discuss the decision with Mateo Busquets Ferrer, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
90+1' The statistic for corner kicks – 8:3.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
88' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
87' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' The substitution is prepared. Isi Palazon joins the action as a substitute, replacing Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano).
86' Substitution. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) leaves the pitch and is replaced by Adrian Embarba.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
81' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Adria Pedrosa and he is replaced by Valentin Barco (Sevilla).
80' Here comes a substitution. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is brought on as a substitute for Djibril Sow.
80' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.

77' What a great touch by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
74' An accurate cross picks out Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jesus Navas (Sevilla) will replace Peque.
73' Substitution. Dodi Lukebakio is replaced by Suso (Sevilla).
71' Here comes a substitution. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) is given a rest as he is replaced by Sergio Camello.
71' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) will be replaced by Pedro Diaz.
70' The ball is cleared after Isaac Romero (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

68' Sevilla slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
65' The total number of attempts is 7:5.
63' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
61' Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla).
59' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

59' Great save! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Augusto Batalla. Sevilla get a corner.
55' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer who sees an offensive foul.
54' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
53' The linesman raises his flag. Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged offside.
50' The ball is laid off to Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Augusto Batalla to make a decent save.
50' A cross from Peque (Sevilla) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' Kike Salas (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
46' Half-time substitution. Inigo Perez decided to make a change. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is replaced by Pathe Ciss.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Sevilla are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
45+1' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer had no choice but to send Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) off. VAR seen to good effect there!
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' It’s not actually clear who made that challenge, so referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer will consult VAR before possibly issuing a red card.
43' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
41' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
40' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Loic Bade (Sevilla) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
40' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets Ferrer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
36' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
34' What a great touch by Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
31' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
30' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' 1 - 0 Djibril Sow (Sevilla) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb inside the right post. What a beautiful finish that is!
26' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

21' What a huge chance for Isaac Romero (Sevilla). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
20' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
18' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but Augusto Batalla punches the ball away.
15' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
12' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

11' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Augusto Batalla pulls off an easy save. Sevilla win a corner.
9' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
5' A cross from a corner kick by Sevilla is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
4' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' Alvaro Fernandez leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
1' The first half has just begun.
Rayo Vallecano will kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer will supervise the game today.
